def transform(g):
    vals=[v for r in g for v in r]
    base=collections.Counter(vals).most_common(1)[0][0]
    c=next(v for v in set(vals) if v!=base)
    pts=[(i,j) for i,r in enumerate(g) for j,v in enumerate(r) if v==c]

    return o
